chunks: Al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd, from Muḥammad ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Ibrāhīm al-Khazzāz, from ʿUthmān al-Nawwā’, who said:
I said to Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام: I wash the dead.
He said: “And do you do it well?” He said: I said: “I do wash [them].”
He said: “When you wash the deceased, then be gentle with him, do not wring him, and do not bring any camphor near anything of his ears.”

key_terms.أَغْسِلُ: I perform the washing, here referring to washing the deceased
key_terms.بِكَافُورٍ: with camphor, used in funerary washing
key_terms.فَارْفُقْ: be gentle and treat with care

ai.seo_question: How should the deceased be treated during ghusl according to Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives instruction on the proper handling of the deceased during ghusl. It emphasizes gentleness, avoiding rough treatment, and refraining from placing camphor near the ears, reflecting both fiqh guidance and respect for the dead.
